name: Moonfire
description: Burn an enemy with lunar energy.

name: Sunfire
description: Burn all nearby enemies with solar energy.

name: Wrath
description: Hurl a ball of nature energy at an enemy.

name: Starfall
description: Call down stars to damage all enemies in an area.

name: Bear Form
description: Shift into a bear for increased defense and threat.

name: Cat Form
description: Shift into a cat for stealth and agility.

name: Travel Form
description: Shift into a travel form for increased speed.

name: Rejuvenation
description: Place a healing over time effect on an ally.

name: Regrowth
description: A quick heal that also leaves a HoT.

name: Wild Growth
description: Heal multiple allies over time.

name: Tranquility
description: Channel powerful healing to all nearby allies.

name: Entangling Roots
description: Root an enemy in place with vines.

name: Hurricane
description: Create a violent storm that damages and slows.

name: Barkskin
description: Your skin becomes bark, reducing damage taken.

name: Thorns
description: Shield that damages attackers.

name: Natures Cure
description: Remove curses, poisons, and magic effects.

name: Rebirth
description: Resurrect a fallen ally during combat.

name: Incarnation
description: Empower your current form significantly.

name: Treant Form
description: Transform into a treant for enhanced healing.

name: Force of Nature
description: Summon treant allies to fight or heal.
